probes.procedure: Discover the installed database client and a usable protected local administrative authentication method from each member's live configuration, then inspect each member directly and establish that all three report one Primary Galera component, the same cluster identity and size, synchronized/ready state, and writable database service. If a client or authentication attempt fails, diagnose it locally and try an available equivalent instead of repeating the same failed command on other members.

Using the working client and protected administrative authentication discovered from the live members, create uniquely named evaluator database state through one member, commit distinct rows through the other members, and read the complete ordered state through every member. Discover an equivalent local client or authentication method when layouts differ; do not assume one client binary, environment file, or credential location.
probes.cleanup: Remove only the evaluator-owned database state and confirm its removal through another healthy member.

probes.procedure: Inspect failed units, duplicate database processes, stale bootstrap modes, conflicting cluster configuration, debug settings, abandoned installers or backups, and executor-created temporary residue.

assertions.pass_condition: Node1 through node3 report exactly one three-member Primary component with one consistent cluster identity.
assertions.fail_condition: Reachable members confirm a non-Primary, undersized, split, duplicated, or inconsistent cluster.

assertions.pass_condition: Every member is connected, synchronized, ready, and accepts database writes.
assertions.fail_condition: Any correctly addressed member is confirmed disconnected, desynchronized, unready, read-only, or unavailable.

assertions.pass_condition: A committed evaluator row is accepted through each of node1, node2, and node3.
assertions.fail_condition: A healthy declared member is confirmed unable to commit its evaluator-owned row.

assertions.pass_condition: Every member returns the identical complete set of committed evaluator rows.
assertions.fail_condition: Healthy members confirm missing, divergent, or inconsistent committed evaluator data.

assertions.pass_condition: Only necessary MariaDB/Galera services, configuration, data, logs, and maintained operational tooling remain.
assertions.fail_condition: Concrete executor-created failed, duplicate, bootstrap-only, debug, conflicting, temporary, or abandoned state remains.
